calibration_sources: LangGraph StateGraph / Send API (Parallel Map-Reduce & Command Direct Handoff Architectures)
OpenAI Swarm / Agents SDK Handoff Primitives vs Microsoft AutoGen GroupChat Token Scaling Studies
MAST (Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail? Taxonomy of Inter-Agent Misalignment & Context Pollution)

workload.workflow_scenario: Enterprise 6-Agent Incident Triage & Order Resolution Workflow (Planner, LogAnalyzer, MetricFetcher, PolicyChecker, PatchCoder, Verifier)
workload.traffic_scale: 1,000 Multi-Agent Workflows (requiring 4-8 specialized agent invocations & 3 independent data-gathering branches)
workload.failure_modes: Quadratic shared-chat context dilution, polite chatter loops ('Thank you, I agree'), and supervisor relay truncation

tiers.name: Tier 1: 全员广播群聊 (All-to-All GroupChat -> O(K^2) 上下文膨胀 + 18.5% 客套死循环)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: All-to-All Broadcast GroupChat (O(K^2) Context Bloat & 18.5% Loop Rate)
tiers.topology_and_state_model: Every agent receives the entire growing chat transcript of all 6 agents on every turn
tiers.routing_and_parallelism: LLM speaker-selection prompt picks next speaker serially; prone to polite chatter loops
tiers.recommended_for: Open-ended creative brainstorming demos (<3 agents); strictly banned in production enterprise workflows.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 中心化 LLM Supervisor 轮询中转 (星型传话筒 -> 串行延迟翻倍 + 14.2% 传话丢细节)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Centralized LLM Supervisor Hub-and-Spoke Relay (Serial Bottleneck)
tiers.topology_and_state_model: Workers only talk to a central 70B Supervisor LLM that summarizes & relays every hop
tiers.routing_and_parallelism: Doubles LLM hop count (Worker A -> Supervisor -> Worker B) and loses exact JSON fields during summarization
tiers.recommended_for: Simple 2-worker sequential routing where tasks cannot be structured as a graph.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 显式有向图状态机 (LangGraph StateGraph / Temporal Durable DAG · 代码守卫边)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Deterministic Sequential StateGraph / Durable DAG (Code-Guarded Edges)
tiers.topology_and_state_model: Explicit state machine where transitions are guarded by deterministic code predicates + checkpoint replay
tiers.routing_and_parallelism: Eliminates infinite loops (0.2%), but sequential node execution & shared global state dictionary limit speed
tiers.recommended_for: Standard linear compliance workflows requiring deterministic audit trails and durable crash replay.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 并行 Fan-Out DAG + 强类型作用域黑板 (Typed Blackboard) + 零跳直接交接 (Command Handoff)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Parallel Fan-Out DAG + Scoped Typed Blackboard + Direct 0-Hop Handoffs
tiers.topology_and_state_model: Each agent reads/writes only its Pydantic-typed Blackboard slice (2.4K tok view) + parallel Send/Map-Reduce branches
tiers.routing_and_parallelism: 3 parallel workers run concurrently + Direct Command(goto=...) handoffs skip central Supervisor turns
tiers.recommended_for: Production enterprise multi-agent systems demanding <6s latency, 93.6% accuracy, 10x fewer tokens, and zero loop hangs.
